entries.title: Importance of Topical Authority for SEO (Koray / Holistic SEO)
entries.summary: Topical authority is a ranking state built from connected entity/attribute coverage under a clear source context — not a blog calendar.
takeaways: Cover information gaps (EAV facts), not just keyword gaps
Build supporting nodes before expecting head-term money pages to stick
Historical consistency compounds after initial ranking
entries.whyItMatters: Core doctrine for Feeling Yachty charter SEO and Corey’s approval-gated proposals.

entries.title: How to Expand a Topical Map for Higher Topical Authority
entries.summary: Expand maps with contextual bridges so outer topics still reinforce the charter core instead of diluting it.
takeaways: Define source context first (FY = private yacht charter / experiences)
Reject outer nodes without a strong bridge to core
Brand identity EAV is part of the map, not an afterthought
entries.whyItMatters: Prevents n8n auto-blogging from flooding WordPress with off-map posts.

entries.title: Entity–Attribute–Value model for semantic content systems
entries.summary: Pages should be configured as entity + attributes + values so engines can match query needs with less retrieval cost.
takeaways: Briefs need EAV tables, not just outlines
Algorithmic authorship works when attributes are explicit
Never invent fleet/pricing values — leave gaps marked
entries.whyItMatters: Sets the quality bar for every Feeling Yachty money-page brief.

entries.title: SEO in 2026: What will stay the same (Search Engine Land)
entries.summary: Trust, crawlable structured information, and meeting real user needs remain the durable SEO foundations even as AI surfaces change.
takeaways: Semantics + topical authority still compound for local/experience queries
Thin AI posts without entity coverage will keep failing
Stay current weekly — do not freeze on last year’s playbook
entries.whyItMatters: Confirms Pacman’s standing order: continuous SEO study + enforce map-first publishing.

entries.title: Key web development trends for 2026 (AI-assisted workflows, modern frameworks)
entries.summary: 2026 web work is shifting toward AI-assisted implementation, faster build tooling, and clearer ownership of agentic workflows — which matches PACMAN’s verify-then-ship model.
takeaways: AI accelerates coding; human/Pacman verification still owns production risk
Prefer durable frameworks (Next.js App Router) with simple data files for ops dashboards
Keep learning logs in-repo so Fernando can audit agent study habits
entries.whyItMatters: Keeps Pacman’s developer judgment current while managing MDI agents.

entries.title: WordPress REST API authentication & handbook mirrors
entries.summary: Application Passwords remain the practical auth path for agent-driven WP writes; Elementor pages still sit on WP post meta.
takeaways: Invalid app passwords silently kill n8n → WP push workflows
Prefer REST for posts/media; verify Elementor JSON carefully
Monday docs refresh keeps handbook mirrors current
entries.whyItMatters: Directly related to FY WP Push Test failures and auto-blogging reliability.

entries.title: Feeling Yachty GHL/n8n system overview (live inventory)
entries.summary: GHL is CRM hub; n8n owns bots (AI Sales, Omni Router, Support, Mom Bot, Viator) and booking intake (Bokun/Woo/WP).
takeaways: Phones into GHL must be E.164
Viator real payloads use activityBookings
WordPress→GHL Sync has been silent — treat as ops risk
entries.whyItMatters: Pacman cannot verify SEO/dev work without knowing the booking + CRM stack.

entries.title: Koray Topical Authority + Topical Map research (skill pack training)
entries.summary: Corey re-trained on public Holistic SEO materials operationalized in skills/seo-corey-tongberg for Feeling Yachty Miami/Panama charter.
takeaways: Map before content
One owner URL per query cluster (anti-cannibalization)
Multi-query SERP intent clustering before briefs
entries.whyItMatters: Raises the bar on every feeling.com proposal that needs owner Approve.

entries.title: Entity SEO + Entity Identity Management case studies
entries.summary: Entity-oriented coverage and brand identity corroboration drive durable rankings beyond classic keyword targeting.
takeaways: Extract attributes from ranking documents, not invent them
Brand SERP / identity consensus protects Feeling Yachty queries
Supporting hubs should feed money URLs, not replace them
entries.whyItMatters: Shapes the sitemap gap audit currently waiting for approval.

entries.title: Semantic SEO for 2026 — entities, intent, and topic systems
entries.summary: 2026 consensus continues to favor entity + intent systems over isolated keywords — aligned with Turberg/Koray practice.
takeaways: Query networks > keyword lists
Intent clusters determine content format (FAQ, itinerary, comparison)
Stay weekly-current; Google surfaces keep shifting
entries.whyItMatters: Keeps Corey’s proposals modern without chasing every shiny tactic.

entries.title: OnCrawl: Importance of Topical Authority (Koray case summary)
entries.summary: Practical checklist from Koray’s OnCrawl write-up: map-first, internal links, contextual vectors, historical data.
takeaways: Internal links are part of the topical graph, not decoration
Publish cadence is a ranking input
Cite source metrics only — never invent FY traffic claims
entries.whyItMatters: Executable checklist for Pacman verification of Corey’s implementations.

entries.title: PACMAN command-center architecture (Next.js App Router + JSON store)
entries.summary: Fleet board, approvals, and per-agent progress pages as the ops UI for MDI agents.
takeaways: Approval gate before production writes
Pacman verification is mandatory after implement
Keep durable history in-repo, not only in chat
entries.whyItMatters: Foundation for the Learning tab and Fernando visibility.

entries.title: Slack #n8n-errors as live ops feed for GHL/booking failures
entries.summary: Phone E.164 failures and activityBookings shape bugs blocked Bokun→GHL — ops learning feeds product fixes.
takeaways: Treat Slack incident notes as training data
Document fixes in PACMAN /n8n docs
Learning tab should capture ops postmortems too
entries.whyItMatters: Pacman verifies agents against real stack failure modes.
